ms.report:
Dear Reviewer Team, 
we have uploaded the new version of our testnet to Github. 
We have made the website accessible on https://preprod.dao.muesliswap.com 
The code is accessible in our Github repository together with a detailed README.md https://github.com/MuesliSwapTeam/dao-governance-dashboard
Moreover, I updated our usage guide for you: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Svac5slZiuwEcoAwO9p1JkqsjC5MfeAqPVsXUa_ZHjg/edit?usp=sharing
Moreover, I included some example transactions linking to Cardano scan showcasing the different functionalities 
・Stake tMILK in the DAO Governance contract https://preprod.cardanoscan.io/transaction/371b95d4bd5aef4f8a977178f44a92a153b2aedc9989254ae4c7e17c795a38fb
・Unstake tMILK in the DAO Governance contract (transaction checks if stake is not participating in current votes) https://preprod.cardanoscan.io/transaction/79e77b13767390356fa455267de808fb5d030f7bd67373d0f0eb018bac485d2d
・Participate in Governance Vote (Tally) with staked tMILK: https://preprod.cardanoscan.io/transaction/78e200cb3a97609c9813bc46b8b4b61d7fd5bce3f2c5fc09fdd8117153a75032
・Create Tally (i.e. use the current DAO (governance thread)) and create a proposal by executing the contract and creating a tally that is linked to the Governance Thread: https://preprod.cardanoscan.io/transaction/6a5bda466672f2e4c91d363d6b9ed060acbfff268ea6ce7a50f6b0b7b6180307?tab=utxo
